selection_population: ordinary answerable DEV plus structural P_COMPLEX diagnostics
tie_policy: first lexicographic winner after deterministic configuration and epoch ordering

interpretation.HIERARCHY_IMPROVES_RERANKING: H beats B0 on all three ordinary primary metrics and both structural primary metrics, with unchanged candidate membership and invariant Hit@100/structural@100.
interpretation.HIERARCHY_MIXED_RESULT: H improves at least one preregistered primary family while not satisfying the all-primary improvement rule and without candidate/integrity failure.
interpretation.HIERARCHY_DEGRADES_RERANKING: H is below B0 on any ordinary primary metric without compensating all-primary structural improvement, or any integrity/candidate invariant fails.
interpretation.uncertainty: Source-level paired bootstrap intervals will be reported in R2; no outcome threshold is selected from TEST.
